name: Sodexo for WooCommerce
author: TechSkype

sections.description:
This is the official Sodexo payment gateway plugin for WooCommerce. As a business owner, you can integrate your web or mobile application with Sodexo E-Comm RESTful APIs that enable you to accept Sodexo and Zeta money from users.

This is compatible with WooCommerce >= 5.0, including the new 8.x release with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) support.

Dependencies

  1. WordPress v5.8 and later
  2. Woocommerce v5.0 and later
  3. PHP v7.4 and later
  4. php-curl extension

Configuration

  1. Visit the WooCommerce settings page, and click on the Checkout/Payment Gateways tab.
  2. Click on Sodexo to edit the settings. If you do not see Sodexo in the list at the top of the screen make sure you have activated the plugin in the WordPress Plugin Manager.
  3. Enable the Payment Method, name it Sodexo and Zeta money (this will show up on the payment page your customer sees), add in your API Key, ACQUIRER, MID and TID.

License

The Sodexo WooCommerce plugin is released under the GPLv2 license, same as that
of WordPress. See the LICENSE file for the complete LICENSE text.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. To use this plugin correctly, you need to be able to make network requests. Please make sure that you have the php-curl extension installed.
